Detailed Description: A unique identifier assigned to each ride booking. It is used to distinguish one booking from another and has no predictive value for machine learning.

Short Description: Date and time when the booking was made.
Detailed Description: The date and time when the customer submitted the booking request. This can be used to derive features such as booking hour, weekday, or seasonality.
The hour of the day (0–23) when the booking was made. Useful for identifying peak travel periods and customer booking behaviour.
The day of the week when the booking was made (e.g., Monday, Friday). Travel demand and cancellation patterns often vary across weekdays and weekends.
The calendar month in which the booking occurred. Useful for analysing seasonal trends.
Indicates whether the booking was made on a weekend (Yes/No or 1/0). Weekend travel behaviour often differs from weekdays.
Indicates whether the booking occurred during peak commuting hours when demand is typically high.
Indicates whether the booking was made during late-night hours when driver availability may be lower.
Indicates whether the booking occurred on a public holiday, which may influence demand and driver availability.
The geographical area where the customer requested pickup.
The category of the pickup area (e.g., residential, commercial, airport).
The geographical destination requested by the customer.
The category of the destination area (e.g., residential, commercial, airport).
Indicates whether the trip involves an airport. Airport trips may have different cancellation behaviour due to flight schedules.
Indicates whether the trip involves the Central Business District, where traffic and demand are often higher.
Estimated travel distance from pickup to destination in kilometres before the trip starts.
Estimated travel time in minutes based on the planned route and expected traffic conditions.
The ride service selected by the customer (e.g., Standard, Premium, XL).
The payment option selected by the customer, such as cash or card.
Classification of the customer based on usage behaviour, loyalty, or business rules.
The customer's membership or rewards level within the platform.
Number of days since the customer first registered with the platform.
Number of rides booked by the customer during the previous seven days.
Number of rides booked by the customer during the previous thirty days.
The proportion of the customer's bookings that were cancelled during the previous 90 days. A higher value indicates a stronger history of cancelling rides.
The total number of bookings cancelled by the customer before the current booking.
The customer's average waiting time for previous bookings, measured in minutes.
Average rating received by the customer from drivers.
Average rating received by the assigned driver from customers.
Estimated number of available drivers in the pickup zone at booking time.
Estimated number of booking requests in the pickup zone at booking time.
Ratio of available drivers to booking demand. Lower values indicate driver shortages and potentially longer waiting times.
Number of available drivers located near the pickup location when the booking was made.
Number of drivers who rejected the booking request before one accepted it.
Time, in seconds, taken for a driver to accept the booking after it was requested.
Estimated distance between the assigned driver and the customer's pickup location.
Estimated number of minutes for the assigned driver to arrive at the pickup location.
Weather condition at the time of booking (e.g., Sunny, Rainy, Stormy).
Indicates whether it was raining at the time of booking.
Traffic condition at booking time (e.g., Low, Medium, High). Heavy traffic can increase waiting time and cancellation risk.
Dynamic pricing multiplier applied because of demand exceeding available driver supply.
Indicates whether the surge multiplier changed after the booking was created.
Indicates whether a promotional discount or voucher was applied to the booking.
Value of the promotional discount applied to the booking, measured in Singapore dollars (SGD).
Estimated fare for the trip before it begins, measured in Singapore dollars (SGD).
Version of the mobile application used to make the booking.
Quality of the customer's mobile network connection during booking (e.g., Good, Fair, Poor).
Target variable for machine learning. Value 1 indicates the customer cancelled the booking before pickup, while 0 indicates the booking was not cancelled.
Reason recorded for the customer's cancellation, such as long waiting time or high fare. This column should not be used for prediction because it is only known after a cancellation occurs.
